title: kya ataae qudrat hai hum hussain wale hai
body:
kya ataae qudrat hai -ham hussain wale hai
ye hamari qismat hai,-ham hussain wale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ham nabi ke aashiq hai ham ali ke deewane
aur hassan se nisbat hai-ham hussain wale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ham se fatima zahra kar chuki hai ek waada
ab hamaari jannat hai-ham hussain wale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
apne qoo'n se likhte hai apna daastaa'n ham qud
ye bhi ek alaamat hai-ham hussain wale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
unki yaad me jeena unpe jaan dedena
ye hamari aadat hai-ham hussain wale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ya ali ki mid'hat hai ya hussain ka maatam
har nafas ibaadat hai-ham hussain wale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
unke gham me ro dena aur qushi me qush hona
ye hamaari fitrat hai-ham hussain wale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hum bataate dunya ko ham se puchti dunya
gham me kitni lazzat hai-ham hussain wale hai
